rules.statement: Only the owner of an apiary may add hives to it.
rules.subject: hive registration requester

rules.statement: Only the owner of a hive may record inspections for it.
rules.subject: inspection recorder

rules.statement: The number of brood frames recorded in an inspection must be a whole number of 0 or more.
rules.subject: inspection brood frames

rules.statement: An inspection's temperament score must be at least 1.
rules.subject: inspection temperament score

rules.statement: An inspection's temperament score must be at most 5.
rules.subject: inspection temperament score

rules.statement: The mite count per 100 bees recorded in an inspection must be a finite number of 0 or more.
rules.subject: inspection varroa mites per 100 bees

rules.statement: A hive is flagged as needing treatment when an inspection finds more mites per 100 bees than the treatment threshold.
rules.subject: hive varroa mites per 100 bees

rules.statement: A flagged hive stays flagged until a treatment has been recorded and a later inspection finds mites at or below the treatment threshold.
rules.subject: hive treatment flag clearance
